units.title: Happy Holiday

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 不定代词与一般过去时

units.grammarTitle: 不定代词与一般过去时

grammarQuiz.q: I didn't go ___ special during the holiday.
grammarQuiz.point: 不定代词(否定句用 anywhere)

grammarQuiz.q: We ___ to an ancient town last summer.
___ tasted good, especially the fish.
Did you meet ___ interesting on your trip?
grammarQuiz.point: 不定代词(疑问句用 anyone)

grammarQuiz.q: There was ___ to do, so we stayed in the hotel.

reading.passage: Last summer, I had a fantastic vacation with my family. We went to an ancient town in the south of China. The landscape there was beautiful, with green mountains and a quiet river. We didn't go anywhere by car; we just walked everywhere. A friendly guide showed us around and told us many old stories. We stayed in a comfortable little hotel near the river. The food was great, especially the steamed fish. I never felt bored — every day brought something new. On the last evening, I took lots of photos to remind me of this special trip. It was the best holiday I have ever had!
reading.passageCn: 去年夏天，我和家人度过了一个极好的假期。我们去了中国南方的一座古镇。那里风景优美，有青山和一条静静的河。我们没有坐车去任何地方，只是到处步行。一位友好的导游带我们参观，给我们讲了许多古老的故事。我们住在河边一家舒适的小旅馆里。食物很棒，尤其是清蒸鱼。我从未感到无聊——每天都有新鲜事。最后一晚，我拍了很多照片，好让自己记住这次特别的旅行。这是我度过的最好的假期！

questions.q: Where did the writer go on vacation?
opts: An ancient town in the south of China

questions.q: How did they get around in the town?
Why did the writer take lots of photos?
opts: To remind himself of the special trip

questions.q: What did the writer like to eat most during the vacation?
What can we infer about how the writer felt during the trip?

writing.prompt: Write about a holiday you had. Where did you go? What did you do? Use the simple past tense and indefinite pronouns (something, anywhere, nothing ...).
writing.promptCn: 写一写你度过的一个假期。你去了哪里？做了什么？用一般过去时和不定代词（something / anywhere / nothing 等）。
writing.opener: Last summer, I had a great holiday.

cards.hint: 如 an ancient town
如 my family
如 walked, took photos

l1: Last summer, I went to {place}.
I went there with {who}.
We {activity}.
It was a fantastic holiday!
l2: Last summer, I had a fantastic vacation in {place}.
I went there with {who}.
The landscape was beautiful, and we {activity}.
I didn't feel bored at all!
l3: Last summer, I had one of the best holidays in {place}.
I travelled there with {who}, and everything was new to me.
We {activity}, and the food was great, especially the local dishes.
I took many photos to remind me of this special trip.

quizQuestions.explanation: **vacation** 意为"假期"，如 a summer vacation 暑假，go on vacation 去度假。
**ancient** 意为"古老的"，常修饰名胜古迹，如 an ancient temple 古老的寺庙。
**landscape** 意为"风景；景色"，多指自然景观，如 a beautiful landscape 美丽的风景。

quizQuestions.q: 选出过去式：We ___ to the mountains last week.
quizQuestions.explanation: 一般过去时表过去发生的动作，last week 为过去时间标志，go 的过去式是 **went**，故选 went。

quizQuestions.q: I didn't see ___ on the empty street.
quizQuestions.explanation: 否定句中表"任何人"用 anyone，I didn't see **anyone** 我没看见任何人；no one 不能再与 didn't 连用（双重否定）。
**remind** 意为"提醒"，常用 remind sb. of sth. 使某人想起某事。

quizQuestions.q: ___ special happened — it was a normal day.
quizQuestions.explanation: 句意"没什么特别的事发生"，主语表"没有任何事"用不定代词 **Nothing**，本身含否定。
**comfortable** 意为"舒适的"，如 a comfortable bed 舒适的床。

listeningQuestions.audio: I went to Mount Huangshan with my family.
The landscape there was amazing.
I didn't go anywhere special this holiday.
We stayed in a comfortable hotel for three days.
opts: They stayed in a nice hotel.

listeningQuestions.audio: A guide showed us around the old town.
I took many photos to remember the trip.

units.title: Home Sweet Home
units.bigQuestion: What does home mean to you?

grammarQuiz.q: "___ you pass me the glue, please?" — Sure, here you are.
"Can I borrow your scissors?" — "Yes, ___."
"Could I ___ a poster on the wall?" Mum said it was fine.
grammarQuiz.point: 情态动词后接动词原形

grammarQuiz.q: Choose the most polite way to ask a stranger for help.
grammarQuiz.point: Could 比 Can 更礼貌

grammarQuiz.q: "Can I water the plants?" — "No, you ___. They were watered already."

reading.passage: My family just moved into a new apartment, and we are making it our home. "Could you help me pack these books?" Mum asked me on the first morning. I sorted them and put them on the shelf. "Can I decorate my bedroom?" I asked. "Of course you can," she said with a smile. I put up a big poster and added some photos to the wall. My little sister wanted to help too. "Could I water the plants on the balcony?" she asked. Mum nodded. In the evening, we invited our new neighbours to dinner. "Can I borrow some plates?" Mum asked them kindly. Soon our living room was full of warm voices. Home is not just a place. Home is the people we love.
reading.passageCn: 我们一家刚刚搬进一套新公寓，正在把它变成我们的家。第一天早上，妈妈问我：“你能帮我把这些书打包吗？”我把书整理好放到书架上。我问：“我可以装饰我的卧室吗？”她笑着说：“当然可以。”我贴了一张大海报，又往墙上加了一些照片。我的小妹妹也想帮忙。她问：“我可以给阳台上的植物浇水吗？”妈妈点了点头。傍晚，我们邀请了新邻居来吃晚饭。妈妈客气地问他们：“我可以借几个盘子吗？”很快，我们的客厅里就充满了温暖的话语。家不只是一个地方，家是我们所爱的人。

questions.q: Why did the family move?
opts: They moved into a new apartment.

questions.q: What did the writer do to decorate the bedroom?
opts: Put up a poster and added photos.

questions.q: What does the writer mainly want to say at the end?
opts: Decorating a room is hard work.
Home is about the people we love.

questions.q: What did the writer's little sister want to do to help?
opts: Water the plants on the balcony

questions.q: What did Mum ask the new neighbours when they came to dinner?

writing.prompt: Write about how you help at home and how you make your home nice. Use Can/Could to ask for permission or help politely.
writing.promptCn: 写一写你在家里如何帮忙以及如何把家布置得温馨。请用 Can/Could 来礼貌地请求帮助或许可。
writing.opener: My home is a sweet place, and I always try to help.

cards.hint: 如 pack up books, sort old toys
如 put up a poster, add some photos
如 Could you help me...?

l1: I often {help} at home.
I like my {decorate}.
"Could you help me?" I ask.
My home is sweet.
l2: After school, I usually {help} to make my home tidy.
I love to {decorate} my room to make it nice.
I always say, "{ask}" when I need help.
I feel happy and warm at home.
l3: When I get home, I {help} so that everyone can relax in a clean house.
To make my bedroom cosy, I {decorate} it with the things I love.
I ask politely, "{ask}", because good manners matter at home.
For me, home is not just a place but the people I love.

quizQuestions.explanation: **balcony** 意为"阳台"，是房屋向外延伸的露天平台。
**invite** 意为"邀请"，常用 invite sb. to do sth. 邀请某人做某事。

quizQuestions.q: "___ I use your glue for a minute?" — Of course.
quizQuestions.explanation: 礼貌地请求许可用 **Could**"我可以……吗"，比 can 更委婉，故选 Could。
**decorate** 意为"装饰；装点"，如 decorate the room 装饰房间。
**borrow** 意为"借（入）"，borrow sth. from sb. 向某人借某物。

quizQuestions.q: "Can you ___ me a hand with the cleaning?"
quizQuestions.point: 情态动词后接动词原形
quizQuestions.explanation: Can you 之后跟动词原形，give sb. a hand 帮某人一把，故选 **give**。
**sort** 意为"把……分类；整理"，如 sort the books 把书分类。

quizQuestions.q: "Could I ___ the plants?" — Yes, please do.
quizQuestions.point: 情态动词后接动词原形
quizQuestions.explanation: Could I 之后接动词原形构成礼貌请求，**water** 在此作动词"浇水"，故选 water。

listeningQuestions.audio: Could you help me pack up these boxes, please?
opts: He is asking for help to pack boxes.
He is throwing the boxes away.

listeningQuestions.audio: Can I decorate my bedroom with these posters?
opts: She wants to sell the posters.
She is asking permission to decorate her bedroom.

listeningQuestions.audio: We invited our new neighbours to dinner last night.
opts: They asked the neighbours to come for dinner.

listeningQuestions.audio: Could I borrow a few plates for the party?
opts: He is asking to borrow some plates.

listeningQuestions.audio: Can you put the books on the balcony, please?
opts: He wants the books put on the balcony.
He is reading on the balcony.
He is sleeping on the balcony.

listeningQuestions.audio: Could you add some flowers to the living room?
opts: The living room is too small.
She wants flowers added to the living room.
She is moving out of the living room.

units.title: Same or Different?
units.bigQuestion: How do we compare with each other?

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 形容词比较级 + as...as 同级比较

units.grammarTitle: 形容词比较级 + as...as 同级比较

grammarQuiz.q: My brother is ___ than me.
Ann is ___ outgoing than Lily.
Tom runs as ___ as Jack.
This book is ___ interesting than that one.
She is not ___ tall as her sister.

reading.passage: Lily and Ann are good friends, but they are very different. Lily is taller and slimmer than Ann, and she is more outgoing too. She loves to talk and make new friends. Ann is quieter and shyer, but she is just as hard-working as Lily. In fact, Ann gets better grades because she studies harder. Their personalities are not alike, yet they have a lot in common. Both girls enjoy music and sports. They believe these differences make their friendship stronger and more interesting. "My best friend is not the same as me," Lily says, "but that is the best part. She is as important to me as my own family."
reading.passageCn: 莉莉和安是好朋友，但她们非常不同。莉莉比安更高更苗条，也更外向。她喜欢交谈、结交新朋友。安更安静、更害羞，但她和莉莉一样勤奋。事实上，安成绩更好，因为她学习更用功。她们的性格并不相像，但她们有很多共同点。两个女孩都喜欢音乐和运动。她们相信这些差异让她们的友谊更牢固、更有趣。“我最好的朋友和我不一样，”莉莉说，“但那正是最棒的部分。她对我而言就像我自己的家人一样重要。”

questions.q: How is Lily different from Ann in appearance?
Why does Ann get better grades?
What can we learn about their friendship?
What do both Lily and Ann enjoy?
What can we infer about Lily's personality?

writing.prompt: Write about you and your best friend. Use comparatives (-er / more) and 'as ... as' to compare your appearance, personality, and interests.
writing.promptCn: 写一写你和你最好的朋友。用比较级（-er / more）和'as ... as'来比较你们的外表、性格和兴趣爱好。
writing.opener: My best friend and I are alike in some ways, but different in others.

cards.hint: 如 taller, slimmer
如 more outgoing, shyer
如 as ... as in sports

l1: My best friend and I have a similar {appearance}.
He is a little taller than me.
We both have a friendly {personality}.
We share the same {interests}.
l2: In {appearance}, my friend is taller and slimmer than me.
His {personality} is more outgoing than mine, but I am quieter.
In our {interests}, I am as keen on sports as he is.
These small differences make our friendship fun.
l3: When it comes to {appearance}, my friend is taller and slimmer than I am, though we look alike to others.
Our {personality} types are not the same: he is more outgoing, while I am shyer and more serious.
Yet in our {interests} we match well, because I love music as much as he does.
I believe these similarities and differences make our friendship stronger.

quizQuestions.explanation: **outgoing** 意为"外向的"，形容人开朗爱社交，与 shy 害羞的相反。
**similarity** 意为"相似之处"，由 similar 加后缀构成名词。
than 提示比较级，hard-working 是复合形容词，比较级用 **more hard-working**，故选之。
**appearance** 意为"外表；露面"，由 appear 加后缀构成名词。

quizQuestions.q: Anna is just ___ smart ___ her brother.
quizQuestions.explanation: 表"和……一样"用同级比较 **as...as**，as smart as 和……一样聪明，故选 as...as。
**slim** 意为"苗条的"，形容身材纤细，如 a slim girl 苗条的女孩。

quizQuestions.q: This problem is ___ serious than that one.
quizQuestions.explanation: than 提示比较级，serious 较长须用 **more** serious 构成比较级，故选 more。
**friendship** 意为"友谊；友情"，由 friend 加后缀构成名词。

listeningQuestions.audio: My sister is more outgoing than me.
opts: His sister is more outgoing than him
His sister is shyer than him
He is more outgoing than his sister

listeningQuestions.audio: Tom is as hard-working as Jack.
opts: Tom works as hard as Jack

listeningQuestions.audio: Lily is taller and slimmer than Ann.
opts: Lily and Ann are the same height
Lily is taller and slimmer than Ann

listeningQuestions.audio: We have a lot in common.
My best friend is shyer than I am.
opts: I am shyer than my friend
My friend is shyer than me

listeningQuestions.audio: Their personalities are quite different.
opts: Their characters are not the same

units.title: Amazing Plants and Animals
units.bigQuestion: What makes plants and animals amazing?
units.pronunciation: 双元音 + 辅音连缀;句子重音

vocabulary.cn: 精力充沛的；生机勃勃的

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 形容词最高级 + 名词后缀构词

units.grammarTitle: 形容词最高级 + 名词后缀构词

grammarQuiz.q: The cheetah is ___ animal on land.
This is ___ flower in the whole garden.
Of all the plants here, bamboo grows ___.
The blue whale is ___ animal in the ocean.
Which sentence is correct?
opts: She is the happiest girl in class.
She is the happyest girl in class.
She is the most happy girl in class.
She is happier girl in class.

reading.passage: Bamboo is one of the most amazing plants on our planet. It is the fastest-growing plant in the world. On the warmest days, some bamboo can grow up to one metre taller in just twenty-four hours! That makes it grow faster than almost any other plant. Bamboo is also one of the most useful plants. People use it to make tools, houses and even paper. The strongest kinds of bamboo are harder than wood. Pandas think bamboo is the tastiest food of all, and they eat it every day. Bamboo stays green through the coldest winter, so many people believe it is the bravest plant in nature. It is truly one of the greatest gifts from the natural world.
reading.passageCn: 竹子是我们星球上最神奇的植物之一。它是世界上生长最快的植物。在最温暖的日子里，有些竹子在短短二十四小时内能长高一米！这使它比几乎任何其他植物长得都快。竹子也是最有用的植物之一。人们用它来制作工具、房屋甚至纸张。最坚硬的竹子比木头还硬。熊猫认为竹子是所有食物中最美味的，它们每天都吃。竹子在最寒冷的冬天也保持翠绿，所以很多人相信它是大自然中最勇敢的植物。它真的是大自然最伟大的礼物之一。

questions.q: According to the passage, what is bamboo in terms of growing speed?
opts: The fastest-growing plant in the world
The tallest tree on the planet

questions.q: Why do many people believe bamboo is the bravest plant?
opts: It stays green through the coldest winter
It can fly in the wind

questions.q: What can we infer about pandas from the passage?
opts: Pandas enjoy bamboo as their favourite food

questions.q: According to the passage, what do people use bamboo to make?
What does the passage say about the strongest kinds of bamboo?

writing.prompt: Write a short passage about a plant or animal you think is amazing. Use superlatives (the -est / the most ...) to describe why it is special.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇短文，介绍一种你认为最神奇的植物或动物。用最高级（the -est / the most...）描述它为什么特别，比如最快的、最大的或最美丽的。
writing.opener: I think the most amazing living thing is...

cards.hint: 如 the most amazing animal
如 the fastest / the biggest
如 I love it most

l1: I think the most amazing living thing is the {what}.
It is one of the {why} things in nature.
It lives near the ocean and looks very lively.
I love this amazing living thing the most.
l2: The {what} is the most amazing living thing I know.
Many people say it is the {why} of all.
Its tiny wings or shoots make it really special.
That is why I feel it is the greatest gift in nature.
l3: Of all living things on our planet, the {what} is the most amazing to me.
It is famous for being the {why}, faster or bigger than the others.
Whether in the forest or the ocean, it always looks lively and full of life.
For this reason, I believe it is one of the greatest wonders of the natural world.

quizQuestions.explanation: **bamboo** 意为"竹子"，是熊猫爱吃的植物，如 eat bamboo 吃竹子。
**tiny** 意为"极小的；微小的"，比 small 更小，如 a tiny insect 极小的昆虫。

quizQuestions.q: The redwood is ___ tree in the forest.
quizQuestions.explanation: in the forest 表范围用最高级，tall 的最高级是 **the tallest**，故选之。
**pollen** 意为"花粉"，是花朵传播繁殖的微小颗粒。

quizQuestions.q: Among all the animals, the ant is one of ___ workers.
quizQuestions.explanation: one of + 最高级 + 复数名词，busy 的最高级是 **the busiest**，故选之。
**ocean** 意为"海洋"，如 the Pacific Ocean 太平洋。

quizQuestions.q: This is ___ interesting plant in the book.
quizQuestions.explanation: in the book 表范围用最高级，interesting 须用 **the most** 构成最高级，故选之。
**lively** 意为"生机勃勃的；活泼的"，如 a lively city 充满活力的城市。

listeningQuestions.audio: The cheetah is the fastest animal on land.
opts: The cheetah runs faster than any other land animal.
The cheetah is the slowest land animal.
The cheetah lives in the ocean.
The cheetah cannot run at all.

listeningQuestions.audio: Bamboo is one of the most useful plants in the world.
opts: Bamboo is among the most useful plants.

listeningQuestions.audio: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower.
The blue whale is the biggest animal in the ocean.
opts: The blue whale is a tiny fish.
The blue whale lives on land.
No ocean animal is larger than the blue whale.

listeningQuestions.audio: This butterfly has the most colourful wings I have ever seen.
opts: The butterfly's wings are very colourful.
The butterfly is grey and dull.

listeningQuestions.audio: The redwood is one of the tallest trees on the planet.
opts: The redwood is the shortest plant.
The redwood is among the tallest trees.
The redwood grows under the sea.

units.title: What a Delicious Meal!
units.bigQuestion: Why do we learn to cook?

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 感叹句与可数/不可数名词

units.grammarTitle: 感叹句与可数/不可数名词

grammarQuiz.q: ____ delicious meal it is!
grammarQuiz.point: 感叹句 What a+形容词+可数名词

grammarQuiz.q: ____ sweet the pie smells!
We need a little ____ to make the cake.
____ wonderful ingredients these are!
grammarQuiz.point: 感叹句 What+形容词+可数名词复数

grammarQuiz.q: How many ____ do we need for the soup?
grammarQuiz.point: 可数名词与 how many 搭配

reading.passage: What a wonderful smell came from the kitchen last Sunday! My grandma was making her famous pumpkin pie. "Cooking is easy," she said. "You just need a good recipe and fresh ingredients." First, she mixed flour and butter to make the crust. How soft it was! Then she added pumpkin, eggs and a little cinnamon. "What a sweet smell!" I cried. She poured the mixture into a pan and baked it in the hot oven. Twenty minutes later, the pie was ready. How delicious it looked! We ate it together and shared happy memories. "What a perfect afternoon!" Grandma smiled. Now I know why we learn to cook. Cooking brings a family closer and turns simple food into sweet love.
reading.passageCn: 上周日，厨房里飘来多么美妙的香味啊！我奶奶正在做她那有名的南瓜派。“做饭很简单，”她说，“你只需要一份好食谱和新鲜的食材。”首先，她把面粉和黄油混合做派皮。它多软啊！然后她加入南瓜、鸡蛋和一点肉桂。“多甜的香味啊！”我喊道。她把混合物倒进烤盘，放进高温烤箱里烘焙。二十分钟后，派做好了。它看起来多美味啊！我们一起吃，分享着快乐的回忆。“多么完美的下午啊！”奶奶笑着说。现在我明白了我们为什么要学做饭。做饭让一家人更亲近，把简单的食物变成甜蜜的爱。

questions.q: What did Grandma make?
What did she use to make the crust?
Why does the writer think we learn to cook?
What did Grandma add to the mixture after making the crust?
opts: Pumpkin, eggs and a little cinnamon

questions.q: How long did it take to bake the pie in the oven?

writing.prompt: Write a short recipe for your favourite dish. Describe the cooking steps in order using the sequence adverbs First, Next, Then, After that and Finally. Also use exclamatory sentences (What.../How...) to show your feelings about the food.
writing.promptCn: 为你最喜欢的菜写一份简短食谱。用顺序副词 First / Next / Then / After that / Finally 按步骤描述做法，并用感叹句（What.../How...）表达你对这道菜的感受。
writing.opener: My favourite dish is ... . Here is how to make it.

cards.hint: 如 My favourite dish is ... because ...
如 We need eggs, tomatoes, oil ...
如 First, ... Next, ... Finally, ...

l1: My favourite dish is {dish}.
We need {ingredients}.
First, cut up the food. Then, heat the oil. {steps}
What a tasty dish it is!
l2: My favourite dish is {dish}, and it is easy to make.
For the ingredients, we need {ingredients}.
First, cut up the vegetables. Next, heat some oil and add them. Then, boil for a few minutes. {steps}
How delicious it smells!
l3: My favourite dish is {dish}, because it brings my family together.
First, get the ingredients ready: {ingredients}.
Next, cut up everything and heat the oil in a pan. After that, add the food and mix well. Then, boil or bake until it is done. {steps}
Finally, put it on a plate. What a wonderful meal it is!

quizQuestions.explanation: **ingredient** 意为"食材；成分"，如 mix the ingredients 把食材混合在一起。
**recipe** 意为"食谱；烹饪法"，follow a recipe 照着食谱做。
**bake** 意为"烘焙"，如 bake a cake 烤蛋糕，用烤箱来做。
**flour** 意为"面粉"，是不可数名词，做面包需要 some flour。

quizQuestions.q: ____ tasty the soup is! 选择正确的感叹词。
quizQuestions.explanation: 感叹 tasty 时 **tasty** 是形容词，感叹句用 **How** + 形容词 + 主谓，故选 How。

quizQuestions.q: ____ nice recipe this is! 选择正确的感叹词。
quizQuestions.point: 感叹句 What a+可数名词

units.grammarTitle: be going to 与不定式作宾语

grammarQuiz.q: I ___ study computer science next year.
She has decided ___ a new hobby this term.
grammarQuiz.point: 不定式作宾语 decide to do

grammarQuiz.q: ___ you going to make any resolutions this year?

reading.passage: A new term is starting, so I am going to make some plans for myself. First, I have decided to improve my English. I am going to read one English story every week and learn ten new words a day. I know I will sometimes fail, but I am not going to give up. Second, I want to take up a new hobby. I am going to learn to play the guitar, because music helps me relax. I also plan to stay organized and keep my room tidy. My biggest dream is to become an engineer one day, so I am going to study science harder. These mini-goals are not easy, but I am sure I will achieve them if I keep on trying.
reading.passageCn: 新学期开始了，所以我打算为自己制订一些计划。首先，我决定要提高我的英语。我打算每周读一个英语故事，每天学十个新单词。我知道有时会失败，但我不会放弃。其次，我想培养一个新爱好。我打算学弹吉他，因为音乐能帮我放松。我还计划保持有条理，把房间整理干净。我最大的梦想是有一天成为一名工程师，所以我打算更努力地学习科学。这些小目标并不容易，但只要我坚持下去，我相信我一定能实现它们。

writing.prompt: A new term is starting. Write about the plans and resolutions you are going to make for yourself. Use 'be going to' and infinitives (decide to / want to / learn to do). Include your study goal, a new hobby, and your dream job.
writing.promptCn: 新学期开始了。写一写你打算为自己制订的计划和决心。用 be going to 和不定式（decide to / want to / learn to do）。包括你的学习目标、一个新爱好和你的理想职业。
writing.opener: A new term is starting, so I am going to make some plans for myself.

cards.hint: 如 I am going to read more English.
如 I want to take up the guitar.
如 I am going to be an engineer.

l1: A new term is starting, and I have some plans.
For study, I am going to {study}.
For fun, I want to {hobby}.
My dream is to {dream}.
l2: This term, I am going to make a few resolutions.
First, I have decided to {study} to improve myself.
Second, I want to {hobby} so that I can relax.
My biggest mini-goal is to {dream}, so I am going to work hard.
l3: A new term is starting, so I am going to set some mini-goals for self-improvement.
For my study, I have decided to {study}, and I am not going to give up even if I fail.
I also want to {hobby}, and I am going to stay organized and confident.
In the end, my dream is to {dream}; as long as I keep on trying, I am sure I will achieve it.

quizQuestions.explanation: **resolution** 意为"决定；决心"，如 make a resolution 下决心。
**achieve** 意为"(经过努力)达到；完成"，achieve a goal 实现目标。

quizQuestions.q: They are going to ___ a robot for the science show.
quizQuestions.point: be going to + 动词原形
quizQuestions.explanation: **be going to** 后接动词原形，故选 **design**。
**self-improvement** 意为"自我提高"，self- 表"自我"。

quizQuestions.q: He learned ___ the piano when he was young.
quizQuestions.explanation: **learn to do sth** 学做某事，后接不定式，故选 **to play**。
**confident** 意为"自信的"，be confident about/in 对……有信心。

quizQuestions.q: What ___ you going to be in the future?
quizQuestions.point: be going to 特殊疑问句
quizQuestions.explanation: 主语 you 与 be going to 搭配用 **are**，故 What are you going to be。
**take up** 意为"开始学；开始从事"，如 take up a hobby 培养爱好。

units.title: When Tomorrow Comes
units.bigQuestion: What will the future look like?

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 一般将来时 will + 反义词

units.grammarTitle: 一般将来时 will + 反义词

grammarQuiz.q: There ___ more robots in our homes in the future.
grammarQuiz.point: 一般将来时 there will be

grammarQuiz.q: We ___ be able to travel to outer space one day.
There will be ___ pollution if we use clean energy.
___ most people live in outer space? — No, they won't.
___ we go to see the new sci-fi film tonight? — I'd love to.

reading.passage: What will the future look like? Many people make predictions about it. In 50 years, technology will change the way we live. Robots will work everywhere and do almost all our housework. They will also save lives when disasters and emergencies happen. Some jobs today will disappear, but there will be more challenging jobs, such as space pilots and AI experts. Will robots replace humans one day? Most futurists say no. Our creativity and emotional intelligence are important, and AI will not replace these things. There will be less pollution and fewer traffic accidents, because the transport system will be more efficient. How can we prepare for the future? Just accept change, keep learning, and work hard. Today's choices will influence your future.
reading.passageCn: 未来会是什么样子？许多人都对它做出预测。50年后，科技将改变我们的生活方式。机器人将无处不在地工作，几乎包揽我们所有的家务。当灾难和紧急情况发生时，它们还会拯救生命。今天的一些工作会消失，但会出现更多有挑战性的工作，比如太空飞行员和人工智能专家。机器人有一天会取代人类吗？大多数未来学家说不会。我们的创造力和情感智能很重要，人工智能不会取代这些。污染会更少，交通事故也会更少，因为交通系统会更高效。我们该如何为未来做准备？只需接受变化，不断学习，努力工作。今天的选择将影响你的未来。

questions.q: According to the passage, what will robots do in the future?
opts: Do almost all our housework and help in disasters

questions.q: Why won't robots fully replace humans?
opts: Because humans have creativity and emotional intelligence
Because there are too few robots

questions.q: What is the best advice to prepare for the future?
According to the passage, what will happen to pollution and traffic accidents in the future?
opts: There will be more of both
Pollution will rise but accidents will fall
There will be less pollution and fewer accidents

questions.q: What can we infer about future jobs from the passage?
opts: All today's jobs will stay the same
Some old jobs will go, but new challenging ones will appear
Robots will take every job from humans

writing.prompt: What will your life be like in 20 years? Write a short passage about your predictions for the future. Use the simple future tense (will). Talk about your job, where you will live, and your free time.
writing.promptCn: 二十年后你的生活会是什么样？写一段短文，谈谈你对未来的预测。用一般将来时（will），谈谈你的工作、你将住在哪里以及你的休闲生活。
writing.opener: What will my life be like in 20 years? Here are a few of my predictions.

cards.hint: 如 I will become an artist / engineer
如 I will live in the countryside / a smart city
如 Robots will help us; there will be less pollution

l1: What will my life be like in 20 years?
I think I will be a/an {job}.
I will live in {place}.
Technology will make life better. {life}
l2: In 20 years, I will become a/an {job}, and I will work hard at it.
I will live in {place}, close to the things I love.
Robots and AI will help us every day, and there will be less pollution. {life}
I believe these predictions will come true.
l3: What will my life be like in 20 years? Here are my predictions.
I will be a/an {job}, because I will keep learning and trying my best.
I will live in {place}, where life will be peaceful and full of ideas.
Technology will change everything: robots will do the housework, the transport system will be more efficient, and AI will help us solve problems. {life}

quizQuestions.explanation: **prediction** 意为"预测；预言"，make a prediction 做出预测。
**replace** 意为"代替；取代"，replace A with B 用B代替A。

quizQuestions.q: There ___ be fewer cars in the city centre soon.
quizQuestions.explanation: 一般将来时 There **will** be，表"将会有"，故选 will。
**emergency** 意为"突发事件；紧急情况"，in an emergency 在紧急情况下。

quizQuestions.q: There will be ___ traffic accidents with smarter roads. (可数)
quizQuestions.explanation: accidents 是可数名词复数，修饰可数用 **fewer**(更少)，less 修饰不可数。
**futurist** 意为"未来学家"，-ist 后缀表"……家、专业人士"。

quizQuestions.q: ___ we meet outside the cinema at 7:15? — OK, see you then.
quizQuestions.explanation: **Shall we...?** 用于提议"我们……好吗"，故选 Shall。
**efficient** 意为"效率高的"，an efficient way 高效的方法。

units.title: Let's Communicate!
units.pronunciation: 辅音连缀收尾;发音复习

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: if条件句(主将从现) + 名词后缀构词

units.grammarTitle: if条件句(主将从现) + 名词后缀构词

grammarQuiz.q: If you ____ to others carefully, you will understand them better.
grammarQuiz.point: first conditional: if + 一般现在时

grammarQuiz.q: If you keep looking at your phone, the speaker ____ you do not care.
Water ____ if you heat it to 100°C.
grammarQuiz.point: zero conditional: 客观事实用一般现在时

grammarQuiz.q: If she ____ sincere, people will trust her.
grammarQuiz.point: first conditional: if 从句主谓一致

grammarQuiz.q: You will make new friends if you ____ to communicate every day.
grammarQuiz.point: first conditional: if 从句用一般现在时

reading.passage: What makes good communication? First, you must be a good listener. If you really listen to others, you will understand them better. When someone is speaking, pay attention and do not look at your phone. If you keep looking at your phone, the speaker feels you do not care. Second, be sincere and polite. If you speak with a kind voice, people will trust you more. Body language is important too. If you smile, others feel comfortable around you. Online messages can be useful, but they often cause misunderstandings. If you only chat online, you may miss true feelings. So if you have something important to say, talk face to face. Good communication takes practice, but if you try every day, you will surely become better at it.
reading.passageCn: 什么造就了良好的交流？首先，你必须做一个好的倾听者。如果你真正倾听别人，你就会更好地理解他们。当有人在说话时，要专心，不要看手机。如果你一直看手机，发言者会觉得你不在乎。其次，要真诚而有礼貌。如果你用友善的语气说话，人们会更加信任你。肢体语言也很重要。如果你微笑，别人和你在一起就会感到舒服。在线信息可能有用，但它们常常造成误解。如果你只在网上聊天，你可能会错过真实的感受。所以如果你有重要的话要说，就面对面交谈。良好的交流需要练习，但如果你每天都努力，你必定会变得更擅长它。

questions.q: According to the passage, what should you do when someone is speaking?
opts: Pay attention and not look at your phone

questions.q: Why is it better to talk face to face about important things?
opts: Face-to-face talk is faster to type

questions.q: What is the writer's main idea about good communication?
opts: It needs practice and effort every day
It is easy and needs no effort

questions.q: According to the passage, why might online messages be a problem?
opts: They are too slow to send

questions.q: What can we infer about good communication from the passage?
opts: It comes naturally and needs no effort
It can be improved through daily practice
It only depends on speaking loudly
It is mainly about chatting online

writing.prompt: Write a short passage giving three tips on how to communicate well with others. Use conditional sentences (If you..., you will...) to explain what happens when people follow your tips.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇短文，给出三条与他人良好沟通的建议。用条件句（If you..., you will...）来说明人们听从建议后会发生什么。
writing.opener: Good communication is important in our daily life. Here are some useful tips.

cards.hint: 如 If you listen carefully, you will understand others.
如 If you are sincere, people will trust you.
如 If you talk face to face, you will avoid misunderstandings.

l1: First, be a good listener.
If you {listen}, you will understand others.
Second, be {sincere} and polite.
Third, talk {face} about important things.
l2: First, be a careful listener and give people your attention.
If you {listen}, others will feel respected.
If you are {sincere}, people will trust you more.
If you talk {face}, you will avoid many misunderstandings.
l3: Good communication starts with listening: {listen}.
If you pay attention and stay {sincere}, people will trust and like you.
Body language matters too, so smile and look at the speaker.
Finally, for important things, {face}, because it shows you truly care.

quizQuestions.explanation: **listener** 意为"听者"，listen + -er 后缀表"做……的人"。
**misunderstanding** 意为"误解；误会"，mis- 前缀表"错误"。
**sincere** 意为"真诚的"，a sincere smile 真诚的微笑。
**pay attention to** 意为"注意；关注"，to 后接名词。

quizQuestions.q: If you ____ kindly, people will trust you.
quizQuestions.explanation: if 条件句"主将从现"，从句用一般现在时，主语 you 故选 **speak**。

quizQuestions.q: If the weather is hot, ice ____ quickly.
quizQuestions.explanation: if 条件句从句用一般现在时，主语 ice 第三人称单数，故选 **melts**。
**impolite** 意为"不礼貌的；粗鲁的"，im- 前缀表否定。

quizQuestions.q: We ____ communicate better if we listen more.
quizQuestions.explanation: if 条件句"主将从现"，主句用将来时 **will** + 动词原形，故选 will。

You should never listen to others.

opts: Texting online can lead to confusion.

opts: Important things are best discussed in person.

units.title: Time to Relax

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 不定式(目的状语+宾补) + 课余活动动词搭配

units.grammarTitle: 不定式(目的状语+宾补) + 课余活动动词搭配

grammarQuiz.q: My mother asked me ___ the room before dinner.
grammarQuiz.point: 不定式作宾补 ask sb to do

grammarQuiz.q: I do yoga every morning ___ my stress.
The teacher told us ___ afraid of making mistakes.
Many students go on outings ___ themselves after exams.
His coach pushed him ___ harder to get over his fear.
grammarQuiz.point: 不定式作宾补 push sb to do

reading.passage: Everyone needs free time to relax. After a long day at school, I like to do something to forget my stress. Some students play sports to stay strong, while others chat with friends to feel happy. My friend Maya takes up calligraphy to express her feelings. At first, she felt scared and wanted to give up, but her teacher told her to keep trying. Now she can manage a single stroke perfectly! I often go on an outing with my family on weekends to enjoy nature. These activities allow us to rest our minds and reduce stress. Hobbies are not a waste of time. They give us energy to study better and help us become happier people.
reading.passageCn: 每个人都需要空闲时间来放松。在学校度过漫长的一天后，我喜欢做点什么来忘掉压力。一些学生通过运动来保持强壮，而另一些学生则和朋友闲聊来感到快乐。我的朋友马娅学习书法来表达她的感受。起初，她感到害怕，想要放弃，但她的老师告诉她要坚持尝试。现在她能完美地完成一个笔画了！我周末经常和家人出外游玩，享受大自然。这些活动让我们放松心情，减少压力。爱好不是浪费时间。它们给我们能量去更好地学习，并帮助我们成为更快乐的人。

questions.q: Why does Maya take up calligraphy?
questions.explanation: 细节理解：文中 Maya **takes up calligraphy to express her feelings**，故选 To express her feelings。

questions.q: What did Maya's teacher tell her to do when she felt scared?
questions.explanation: 细节理解：她害怕想放弃时，老师 **told her to keep trying**(叫她坚持试)，故选 To keep trying。

questions.q: What is the writer's main idea about hobbies?
opts: Hobbies help us relax and become happier
questions.explanation: 主旨题：末句 hobbies **give us energy to study better and help us become happier people**，故选 Hobbies help us relax and become happier。

questions.q: What does Maya's teacher's advice show about her teacher?
opts: The teacher encourages students not to quit
The teacher only cares about sports
questions.explanation: 推理判断：老师劝她 keep trying、别放弃，说明老师 **encourages students not to quit**(鼓励学生不要放弃)，故选该项。

questions.q: What does the writer often do with family on weekends?
opts: Go on an outing to enjoy nature
questions.explanation: 细节理解：I often **go on an outing with my family on weekends to enjoy nature**，故选 Go on an outing to enjoy nature。

writing.prompt: Write about your favourite free-time activity. Explain what you do to relax and why this hobby is important to you. Use infinitives (to do) to show your reasons and purposes.
writing.promptCn: 写一写你最喜欢的课余活动。说明你做什么来放松，以及为什么这个爱好对你很重要。用不定式（to do）来表达你的原因和目的。
writing.opener: In my free time, I like to

cards.hint: 如 I like to do calligraphy / play sports
如 I do it to reduce my stress
如 It allows me to relax and feel happy

l1: In my free time, I like to {what}.
I do it to {why}.
It allows me to {feel}.
I think this hobby is important to me.
l2: In my free time, I like to {what} to relax.
I started it because I wanted to {why}.
At first I felt scared, but I didn't give up.
Now this activity allows me to {feel}.
l3: After a busy week at school, I like to {what} to forget my stress.
I take up this hobby to {why} and to express myself.

This activity allows me to {feel}, and it helps me become a happier person.

quizQuestions.explanation: **reduce** 意为"减少"，与 increase（增加）相对，如 reduce stress 减压。

**outing** 意为"出外游玩"，如 go on an outing 去郊游。

quizQuestions.q: The instructor asked the new students ___ their fears.

**allow** 意为"使成为可能；允许"，常用 allow sb to do sth。

quizQuestions.q: My parents told me ___ too much time on games.

units.bigQuestion: How do we take care of ourselves?

stages.title: 语法专项

units.grammarTitle: should建议 + 反身代词 + 后缀-ache/-less构词

grammarQuiz.q: You have a fever. You ___ see a doctor right away.
If you feel tired, you ___ take a short rest.
The little boy hurt ___ while he was playing football.
We should learn to take care of ___ and stay healthy.
You shouldn't ___ junk food if you want to be healthy.

reading.passage: Last Sunday, Tom wanted to cook dinner by himself. He turned on the stove, but he was careless and burned his hand. The pain was terrible, so he ran to put his hand under cold water. His sister Lucy heard him and came quickly. "You should not panic," she said calmly. "You could put some clean ice on it." Lucy reminded herself to stay calm and helped Tom. Soon the pain was less. "Thank you," Tom said. "I should be more careful next time. I should learn some first aid to protect myself." Lucy smiled. "We can learn it together. Knowing how to take care of ourselves keeps us safe at home."
reading.passageCn: 上周日，汤姆想自己做晚饭。他打开了炉子，但他很粗心，烫伤了手。疼痛非常厉害，于是他跑去把手放到冷水下面。他的姐姐露西听到声音，很快跑了过来。“你不应该惊慌，”她平静地说，“你可以放一些干净的冰在上面。”露西提醒自己保持冷静，帮助了汤姆。很快疼痛减轻了。“谢谢你，”汤姆说，“下次我应该更小心。我应该学一些急救知识来保护自己。”露西笑了。“我们可以一起学。学会照顾我们自己能让我们在家里更安全。”

writing.opener: To stay healthy, you should take good care of yourself.

cards.hint: 如 you should eat more fruit
如 you could go to bed early

l1: To stay healthy, you should take care of yourself.
About {food}, you should eat more fruit and vegetables.

units.title: Growing Up
units.bigQuestion: How do we deal with our emotions?

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 连词 although / until / so that

units.grammarTitle: 连词 although / until / so that

grammarQuiz.q: ___ I was very tired, I kept practising for the match.
I did not feel better ___ my friend forgave me.
She spoke slowly and clearly ___ everyone could understand her.
___ he felt upset, he did not show his emotion to others.

reading.passage: Last month I felt very upset because I had a big fight with my best friend, Lily. Although we had been close for years, I said some hurtful words to her on purpose, and she stopped talking to me. For days I felt lonely and full of anger. I did not say sorry until my mother advised me to put myself in Lily's shoes. So that I could clear the air, I wrote her a long letter to apologize. I told her how thankful I was for our friendship. Although I was nervous, I gave it to her the next morning. She read it and smiled. Now we are close again, and I feel relaxed and joyful. I learned that we must control our anger so that we do not hurt the people we love.
reading.passageCn: 上个月我很难过，因为我和我最好的朋友莉莉大吵了一架。虽然我们多年来一直很亲密，但我故意对她说了一些伤人的话，她便不再和我说话了。有好几天我感到孤独，满心怒火。直到妈妈劝我设身处地为莉莉着想，我才道歉。为了尽释前嫌，我给她写了一封长信道歉。我告诉她我多么感激我们的友谊。虽然我很紧张，但第二天早上我还是把信给了她。她读完后笑了。现在我们又亲密如初，我感到放松又快乐。我明白了，我们必须控制怒火，以免伤害我们所爱的人。

writing.topic: How I Dealt With a Bad Feeling

grammarQuiz.q: Mount Qomolangma is ___ mountain in the world.

reading.passage: Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world. It stands 8,848 metres above sea level, which is far higher than any other mountain on Earth. Every year, it attracts climbers from all over the world. Climbing it is much harder and more dangerous than climbing other mountains. The weather there is the most changeable of all, and the temperature can drop to forty degrees below zero. The higher climbers go, the colder and more difficult it becomes. To survive, they must be the most determined and best-prepared people. Although the journey is risky, many explorers still believe that reaching the top of this great natural wonder is the most exciting experience of a lifetime.
reading.passageCn: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山。它高出海平面8848米，远比地球上任何其他山都高。每年它都吸引着来自世界各地的登山者。攀登它比攀登其他山更艰难、更危险。那里的天气是所有地方中最多变的，气温能降到零下四十度。登山者爬得越高，天气就越冷、越艰难。为了生存，他们必须是最有决心、准备最充分的人。尽管旅程充满危险，许多探险者仍然相信，登上这座伟大的自然奇观之巅是一生中最激动人心的经历。

cards.hint: 如 Mount Qomolangma, in the south of China

reading.passage: Last summer, a terrible typhoon hit our small town near the sea. I was doing my homework when the wind suddenly became very strong. While my father was closing the windows, the lights went off. We were sitting in the dark when we heard a loud noise. Part of our roof came off! My mother was crying, but my father stayed calm. He warned us to stay away from the windows. While the storm was beating against the house, we listened to the radio for news. The report said the typhoon was slowing down. By morning, the rain had stopped. Our neighbours were cleaning the streets when the rescue team arrived with food and water. We were lucky to be safe.
reading.passageCn: 去年夏天，一场可怕的台风袭击了我们海边的小镇。当风突然变得很强时，我正在做作业。当我父亲正在关窗户的时候，灯灭了。我们正坐在黑暗中，这时听到一声巨响。我们家的一部分屋顶被掀掉了！我妈妈在哭，但我爸爸保持镇定。他提醒我们远离窗户。当暴风雨拍打着房子时，我们听收音机里的新闻。报道说台风正在减弱。到了早晨，雨停了。当救援队带着食物和水到来时，我们的邻居们正在清理街道。我们很幸运能平安无事。

cards.hint: 如 A strong typhoon hit our town while I was ...

units.title: Crossing Cultures
units.bigQuestion: How do we communicate with people from different cultures?

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: so…that/unless/as soon as + 否定前缀&ed/ing辨析

units.grammarTitle: so…that/unless/as soon as + 否定前缀&ed/ing辨析

grammarQuiz.q: The custom was ___ strange ___ the visitor did not know what to do.
You should not start eating ___ the host begins first.
___ the guests arrived, the host greeted them warmly.
grammarQuiz.point: as soon as 时间状语从句

grammarQuiz.q: The meal was ___ delicious ___ everyone wanted more.
___ you respect local traditions, people may think you are rude.

reading.passage: People around the world greet each other in different ways. In Japan, people often bow as soon as they meet, while in France friends may kiss on the cheek. Table manners are different too. In China, it is proper to use serving chopsticks, and you should not put your elbows on the table. In some countries the custom is so strict that you must never start eating unless the host begins first. When you receive food, it is polite to say thank you at once. These customs may seem confusing, but they are so important that learning them helps you make a good impression. Unless you respect local traditions, you may seem rude without knowing it. As soon as you understand other cultures, communicating with people becomes much easier.
reading.passageCn: 世界各地的人们用不同的方式互相问候。在日本，人们一见面常常鞠躬，而在法国，朋友们可能会亲吻脸颊。餐桌礼仪也各不相同。在中国，使用公筷是恰当的，而且你不应该把胳膊肘放在桌上。在一些国家，习俗如此严格，以至于除非主人先开始，否则你绝不能动筷。当你收到食物时，立刻说声谢谢是礼貌的。这些习俗也许看起来令人困惑，但它们如此重要，以至于学会它们能帮你留下好印象。除非你尊重当地传统，否则你可能会在不知不觉中显得粗鲁。一旦你理解了其他文化，与人交流就会变得容易得多。

questions.q: In Japan, what do people often do as soon as they meet?
opts: They put elbows on the table.

questions.q: According to the passage, why is learning customs important?
opts: Because it helps you make a good impression.

questions.q: What can we infer from the passage?
opts: All cultures share the same manners.
Without understanding cultures you may seem rude unintentionally.
Table manners do not matter anywhere.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is a proper table manner in China?
opts: Putting your elbows on the table
Starting to eat before the host

questions.q: What does the passage suggest may happen if you do not respect local traditions?
opts: You will make a good impression
You may seem rude without knowing it

writing.prompt: Your foreign friend will have dinner with a Chinese family. Write an email of at least 40 words giving advice on Chinese customs and table manners. Use so...that, unless, and as soon as at least once each.
writing.promptCn: 你的外国朋友将和一个中国家庭共进晚餐。写一封不少于40词的邮件，就中国习俗和餐桌礼仪给出建议。至少各用一次 so...that、unless 和 as soon as。
writing.opener: Dear Sam, I'm glad you will have dinner with a Chinese family. Here is some advice on our customs.

cards.hint: 如 As soon as you arrive, greet the elders first.
如 It is proper to use serving chopsticks.
如 Unless you follow the custom, you may seem rude.

l1: As soon as you arrive, please {greeting} the elders politely.
At a Chinese table, good {table} are very important.
Unless you show {respect}, people may feel uncomfortable.
These customs are so useful that they help you make a good impression.
l2: As soon as you arrive, you should greet the older people first.
It is proper to use serving chopsticks and keep your elbows off the table.
Unless you respect these traditions, you may seem rude.
Chinese manners are so meaningful that learning them leaves a good impression.
l3: As soon as you walk into the home, please greet the elders first and smile.
When you sit down, use serving chopsticks and never start eating unless the host begins.
Unless you take time to understand these customs, you might seem rude by accident.
These manners may seem confusing at first, but they are so important that following them helps you get along well.

quizQuestions.explanation: **custom** 意为"习俗"，如 local customs 当地风俗。
**proper** 意为"恰当的；正确的"，如 proper manners 得体的礼仪。
**impression** 意为"印象"，如 make a good impression 留下好印象。
**rude** 意为"粗鲁的"，与 polite 礼貌的相对。

quizQuestions.q: The dinner was ___ formal ___ everyone wore nice clothes.
quizQuestions.explanation: **so…that** "如此……以至于"，so + 形容词(formal)+ that 引导结果，故选 so; that。

quizQuestions.q: ___ you greet the elders first, they may feel you are impolite.
quizQuestions.explanation: **unless** "除非；如果不"=if not，表否定条件，故选 Unless。
**greet** 意为"问候；迎接"，如 greet the guests 迎接客人。

quizQuestions.q: ___ the guests sat down, the host served the main dish.
quizQuestions.explanation: **as soon as** "一……就……"，引导时间状语，表两动作紧接发生，故选 As soon as。

listeningQuestions.audio: In Japan, people usually bow as soon as they meet.
opts: Japanese people bow right after meeting.
Japanese people shake hands before meeting.
Japanese people never greet each other.
Japanese people kiss on the cheek.

listeningQuestions.audio: Unless you say thank you, the host may think you are impolite.
opts: You must say thank you, or the host may feel you are impolite.
The host will always think you are polite.
Saying thank you is not necessary.
The host never cares about manners.

listeningQuestions.audio: It is rude to put your elbows on the table while eating.
opts: Putting elbows on the table is bad manners.
You should put elbows on the table.

listeningQuestions.audio: As soon as you receive a gift, it is polite to thank the giver.
opts: You should thank the giver right after receiving a gift.
You should open the gift and say nothing.

listeningQuestions.audio: The custom was so strict that nobody started eating before the host.
opts: There was no custom at the dinner.
The host ate last on purpose.
The strict custom stopped people eating before the host.

listeningQuestions.audio: In France, friends often kiss on the cheek to greet each other.
opts: French friends greet by kissing the cheek.
French friends greet by bowing deeply.
French friends greet by shaking hands only.

units.title: A Good Read
units.bigQuestion: Why should we read great books?

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 现在完成时 + 形容词后缀

units.grammarTitle: 现在完成时 + 形容词后缀

grammarQuiz.q: I ___ already ___ that mystery novel, so you can borrow it.
Have you read this fantasy book ___? — No, not ___.
She has ___ read such an exciting adventure story before; it is all new to her.
Have you ___ met a real detective in your life?
The teacher has ___ recommended a new book to us; we will read it now.

reading.passage: Have you ever read a really good book? I have just finished Journey to the West, and it has already become my favourite story. I have never read such an exciting adventure before. The characters are brave, and the writer has created a magic world full of fantasy. My teacher recommended it to me last month, and I have read it three times since then! Many famous writers have inspired readers for hundreds of years. Have you found a book that you love yet? If you haven't started reading for fun, please try today. A good book can change the way you think, and it has a deep effect on your life.
reading.passageCn: 你读过一本真正的好书吗？我刚刚读完《西游记》，它已经成了我最喜欢的故事。我以前从没读过这么精彩的冒险故事。书中的人物很勇敢，作者创造了一个充满幻想的奇妙世界。上个月我的老师把它推荐给我，从那以后我已经读了三遍！许多著名作家几百年来一直激励着读者。你已经找到一本你喜欢的书了吗？如果你还没有开始为了乐趣而阅读，请今天就试试吧。一本好书能改变你的思维方式，它对你的人生有着深远的影响。

questions.q: What book has the writer just finished?
How many times has the writer read the book?
What can we infer about the writer's attitude to reading?
opts: Reading is valuable and can change people

questions.q: Who recommended the book to the writer?
What can we infer about the writer's opinion of Journey to the West?
opts: It is boring and too long
It is the most exciting adventure the writer has read
It is only suitable for children

writing.topic: Recommend a Good Book to a Friend
writing.prompt: Write an email to a friend recommending a book you have read. Use the present perfect tense (have/has done) with already, yet, never, ever and just to share your experience.
writing.promptCn: 给朋友写一封电子邮件，推荐一本你读过的书。运用现在完成时（have/has done）以及 already、yet、never、ever、just 来分享你的阅读体验。
writing.opener: Dear Lily, I have just finished a wonderful book, and I really want to recommend it to you.

cards.hint: 如 I have just read an adventure / fantasy book called ...
如 I have never read such an exciting story.
如 Have you read it yet? You should try it.

l1: I have just finished a great {book}.
It is an adventure full of fantasy.
I have never enjoyed a book so much. {feeling}
Have you read it yet? {advice}
l2: I have recently read a book and want to share my {feeling}.
The story has already inspired me a lot.
I have never met such brave characters before.
It has had a deep effect on me. {advice}
l3: My {advice} is simple: please read this amazing {book} soon.
The writer has created a world of mystery and fantasy.
I have read it three times, and I still love it. {feeling}
Have you ever found a book that changed your mind?

quizQuestions.explanation: **adventure** 意为"冒险；冒险经历"，如 an adventure story 冒险故事。
**recommend** 意为"推荐；建议"，如 recommend a book to sb。

quizQuestions.q: I have ___ read this book; I know the ending already.
quizQuestions.explanation: 现在完成时"已经"用 **already**，常置于句中，与 know the ending 呼应。
**mystery** 意为"悬疑小说；神秘的事物"，如 solve the mystery 解开谜团。
现在完成时疑问句句末"还"用 **yet**，Have you…yet? 是固定问法。
**inspire** 意为"激励；鼓舞"，如 inspire sb to do sth。

quizQuestions.q: This is the best fiction I have ___ read.
quizQuestions.explanation: 现在完成时表"曾经"用 **ever**，常与最高级连用：the best…I have ever read。
**effect** 意为"影响；结果"，如 have an effect on 对……有影响。

listeningQuestions.audio: I have just finished reading a detective story.
opts: The speaker has only recently completed a detective story.
The speaker will read a detective story tomorrow.
The speaker is writing a detective story.

listeningQuestions.audio: Have you read the new fantasy novel yet?
opts: The speaker is asking if you have already read the fantasy novel.
The speaker has finished the fantasy novel.
The speaker is writing a fantasy novel.

listeningQuestions.audio: My friend has never read a mystery book before.
opts: The friend reads mystery books every day.
The friend has not read a mystery book at any time before.
The friend wrote a mystery book.

listeningQuestions.audio: Our teacher has already recommended three books to us.
opts: The teacher will recommend books next week.
The teacher refuses to recommend books.
The teacher has suggested three books to the class.
The teacher is reading three books now.

listeningQuestions.audio: This adventure story has inspired me to write my own.
opts: The story bored the speaker completely.
The speaker has never read the story.
The story made the speaker want to write a story too.

listeningQuestions.audio: Have you ever met a famous writer?
opts: The writer is very famous now.
The speaker met a writer yesterday.
The speaker is a famous writer.
The speaker is asking about your past experience of meeting a writer.

units.title: Making a Difference

vocabulary.cn: 年纪较大的；上了年纪的

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 现在完成时(for/since) + 形近词辨析

units.grammarTitle: 现在完成时(for/since) + 形近词辨析

grammarQuiz.q: My sister ___ at the animal shelter since last summer.
They ___ money to the charity ___ three years.
Choose the correct sentence.
opts: He has been a volunteer since 2019.
He has been a volunteer for 2019.

grammarQuiz.q: We ___ the elderly ___ we joined the group last year.
How long ___ you ___ in this nursing home?
grammarQuiz.point: How long 提问现在完成时

reading.passage: My name is Lily, and I have been a volunteer at a local charity since 2020. For three years, I have helped the elderly in a nursing home near my school. Every weekend, my team and I provide food and warm clothes for them. We have also donated many books to children in need. Helping others has not always been easy. I have been very busy since I joined the group, but it is worth it. I have learned the value of teamwork, and I have made many new friends. Most of all, I have understood why we should help others. A small effort can make a real difference. I am still willing to do more, and I will never stop.
reading.passageCn: 我叫莉莉，自2020年以来我一直是一家本地慈善机构的志愿者。三年来，我一直在学校附近的一家养老院帮助老人。每个周末，我和我的团队为他们提供食物和暖和的衣服。我们还向有需要的孩子们捐赠了许多书。帮助别人并不总是容易。自从加入这个团队以来，我一直很忙，但这是值得的。我懂得了团队合作的价值，也结交了许多新朋友。最重要的是，我明白了我们为什么应该帮助别人。一点小小的努力就能带来真正的改变。我仍然愿意做得更多，我永远不会停下来。

questions.q: How long has Lily helped the elderly in the nursing home?
What does Lily's team do for the elderly every weekend?
What can we learn about Lily from the passage?
opts: She wants to give up soon
She thinks her effort is worth it
She has never made new friends

questions.q: Besides food and warm clothes, what else has Lily's team donated?
What can we infer about Lily's attitude toward volunteering?
opts: She wants to stop because it is too hard
She thinks it is a waste of time
She is determined to keep helping others
She only does it for new friends

writing.prompt: Write an application email to join the 'Make a Difference' volunteer group. Use the present perfect tense with since/for to talk about what you have done to help others. Explain why you want to join and what you are willing to do.
writing.promptCn: 写一封申请邮件，申请加入“有所作为”志愿者团队。用现在完成时（since/for）谈谈你为帮助别人做过的事，说明你为什么想加入，以及你愿意做什么。
writing.opener: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply to join your 'Make a Difference' volunteer group.

cards.hint: 如 I have helped the elderly since 2022.
如 I have learned the value of helping others.
如 I am willing to provide food and donate books.

l1: I have been a volunteer for two years. {experience}
I have helped the elderly since 2022.
I have donated clothes to people in need. {reason}
My friends and I have provided food for them. {offer}
l2: I want to join because I care about my community. {reason}
I have learned the value of teamwork since then.
Helping others has made me very happy. {experience}
I believe a small effort can make a big difference. {offer}
l3: I am willing to provide food and donate books. {offer}
I have been active in charity events for years. {experience}
I will work hard to make our group successful. {reason}
I hope you will give me a chance to help.

quizQuestions.explanation: **donate** 意为"捐赠"，如 donate money/food 捐钱/捐食物。
**shelter** 意为"庇护所；居所"，如 an animal shelter 动物收容所。
**elderly** 意为"年纪较大的"，如 the elderly 老年人。
**make an effort** 意为"做出努力"，effort 努力，常说 make an effort to do sth。
现在完成时中 **since** + 时间点(2018)，表"自从……以来"，故选 since。

quizQuestions.q: I have lived here ___ ten years.
quizQuestions.explanation: 现在完成时中 **for** + 时间段(ten years)，表"持续一段时间"，故选 for。
**willing** 意为"乐意的；愿意的"，如 be willing to do sth 乐意做某事。

quizQuestions.q: Choose the correct present perfect sentence.
opts: He has provided food since May.
He is providing food since May.
quizQuestions.explanation: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词，且 since + 时间点，只有 **He has provided food since May.** 正确。

listeningQuestions.audio: I have been a volunteer at the nursing home for two years.
